Minerals and Metals Working Group of the Industry Issues Table (1999). Magnesium Industry Options Paper. Report to the National Climate Change Secretariat, October 1999 (Canadian National Climate Change Process). Author organisation not named beyond the working group.

Region: Canada (Norsk Hydro Becancour, Timminco, Magnola). Locators are PRINTED page numbers (footer "Page N"). The paper has no technology-level energy or cost numbers: electrolysis energy (12-15 kWh/kg), casting energy and SO2 system costs are in the Foundation Paper (nccp_1999_003) and Hatch report (nccp_1999_004). Loaded: SF6 cover-gas usage rates per tonne of magnesium by plant, with derived CO2e (GWP 23,900 printed). Capacity table, energy and emission totals in _other-values. TRAPS: (1) SF6 values are USE rates; the paper says most of the gas is emitted but does not give an emission factor. (2) The Becancour rate of 0.5 kg/t is current; the 2003 transitional average is 0.15 and 2004 is zero. (3) Magnola start-up and 18-month rates are projections for a plant not yet built. (4) Dollar amounts have no price year (only the SF6 price is given, in CA$).
